## POST `/api/2.58/files`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a file copy from one path to another path. The `directory_ids`, `directory_names` or `paths` value must be specified. If the `directory_ids` or `directory_names` value is not specified, the file is copied to the source directory specified in the body params. The `paths` value refers to the path of the target file relative to the target directory. If `paths` value is not specified, the file will be copied to the relative path specified in `source_path` under the target directory. The `source_path` value refers to the path of the source file relative to the source directory. To…

## PATCH `/api/2.58/files/antivirus`

**Tier:** T2 (T3 if it destroys, eradicates, disables or overwrites)  

Modifies the antivirus status of a file or managed directory. Use `mark_infected` to mark a file as infected. Use `force_clean` to mark a file as clean (not infected) and allow access to it. Use `force_scan_on_read` to force a scan of the file on the next read access. The `mark_infected` and `force_clean` parameters are mutually exclusive. The `path` query parameter is required when using either `mark_infected` or `force_clean`.
